pythonFunction.name: get_read_type
pythonFunction.description:
Says whether a bill is based on an actual or an estimated meter read, with any estimate
correction. Before calling this tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase while it runs.

Args:
    account_id: Account id of the identified account (REQUIRED).
    period: Billing period key such as 2026-10 (REQUIRED).
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.

Returns:
    dict with ok, period, read_type (actual or estimated), estimate_adjustment and
    corrected_from.
